Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You call an ancestor’s name and reach toward your companion. A translucent hand appears at their shoulder, bracing them against the coming blow.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An adjacent ally before a physical defense.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

A translucent hand braces your friend. Give that defense 1 Boon; afterward the ally may move 1 square to a free square adjacent to you without provoking.
